text:
### Disputed Transactions  
**Resolution Options:**  
**Option A: Refund**
- Customer proves unauthorized OR
- Merchant error confirmed
- Refund within 10 business days
- Add interest if delayed
- Apologize  
**Option B: Educate & Retain**
- Customer authorized but regrets
- Explain terms of service
- No refund (customer's decision)
- Offer to set up safeguards (daily limits, alerts)  
**Option C: Escalate to Merchant**
- Payment dispute (chargeback claim)
- Escalate to card scheme
- Merchant investigation initiated
- Resolution per scheme rules

raw_entities.name: Disputed Transaction Resolution Process
raw_entities.description: End-to-end procedure for resolving customer disputes over transactions, with three distinct resolution paths: refund for unauthorized or merchant error cases, customer education for authorized but regretted transactions, or escalation to merchant via card scheme chargeback claim. The process defines decision criteria, timelines, and customer communication requirements for each path.
context: Customer proves unauthorized OR Merchant error confirmed

raw_entities.name: Unauthorized Transaction or Merchant Error Assessment
raw_entities.description: Initial evaluation step to determine whether the disputed transaction qualifies for refund under Option A, based on evidence of customer non-authorization or confirmed merchant error.
context: Customer proves unauthorized OR Merchant error confirmed

raw_entities.name: Refund Processing
raw_entities.description: Execution step to issue refund to customer within 10 business days when unauthorized transaction or merchant error is confirmed, with interest added if refund is delayed.

raw_entities.name: Customer Apology and Communication
raw_entities.description: Customer-facing communication step to apologize for the unauthorized transaction or merchant error as part of the refund resolution path.

raw_entities.name: Customer Authorization Verification
raw_entities.description: Assessment step to determine whether the customer authorized the disputed transaction, used to route to Option B (education) when authorization is confirmed but customer regrets the purchase.

raw_entities.name: Terms of Service Explanation
raw_entities.description: Educational step to explain relevant terms of service to customer when transaction was authorized but customer regrets the purchase, clarifying why no refund is available.

raw_entities.name: Safeguard Setup Offer
raw_entities.description: Proactive step to offer customer protective measures such as daily transaction limits or transaction alerts to prevent future regretted purchases.
context: Offer to set up safeguards (daily limits, alerts)

raw_entities.name: Merchant Escalation Initiation
raw_entities.description: Step to escalate payment dispute to card scheme and initiate merchant investigation when dispute cannot be resolved through refund or education paths, triggering formal chargeback claim process.

raw_entities.name: Scheme-Based Resolution
raw_entities.description: Final resolution step where dispute is resolved according to card scheme rules following merchant investigation, determining liability and outcome.

raw_entities.name: Transaction Authorization Status Decision
raw_entities.description: Branch point determining whether disputed transaction was authorized by customer or unauthorized/erroneous. Authorized transactions route to Option B (education); unauthorized or erroneous transactions route to Option A (refund).
context: Customer proves unauthorized OR Merchant error confirmed

raw_entities.name: Refund Eligibility Gate
raw_entities.description: Decision gate evaluating whether evidence supports refund issuance under Option A criteria (unauthorized transaction or merchant error confirmed).
context: Customer proves unauthorized OR Merchant error confirmed

raw_entities.name: Merchant Escalation Trigger
raw_entities.description: Decision point determining whether dispute should be escalated to merchant via card scheme chargeback claim (Option C) when refund and education paths are not applicable.

raw_entities.name: Dispute Resolution Officer
raw_entities.description: Operations role responsible for assessing disputed transactions, determining resolution path, and executing refunds or escalations according to the three-option framework.
context: Customer proves unauthorized OR Merchant error confirmed

raw_entities.name: Card Scheme Administrator
raw_entities.description: External card scheme system responsible for processing chargeback claims, coordinating merchant investigation, and determining final resolution per scheme rules.

raw_entities.name: Merchant
raw_entities.description: External party responsible for responding to chargeback claims and providing evidence during merchant investigation phase of Option C escalation.

raw_entities.name: Disputed Transaction
raw_entities.description: A financial transaction on a customer account that is contested by the customer as unauthorized, erroneous, or regretted, triggering the three-option resolution process.

raw_entities.name: Disputing Customer
raw_entities.description: Natural person who initiates a dispute over a transaction, either claiming non-authorization, merchant error, or expressing regret over an authorized purchase.

raw_entities.name: Payment Card
raw_entities.description: Payment card associated with the disputed transaction, subject to chargeback claim procedures and card scheme rules when escalated.
